Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: product page text + asset onboarding

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for the draft and the checklist. Quick notes from Marketplace side:

- Listing type: SaaS is appropriate for your integration. For meter-based billing please provide a short description of the usage dimension (e.g., tokens per request or compute-minutes). SKU naming: keep it short, lowercase, hyphen-delimited, e.g., redwood-inference.standard.
- Pricing: Marketplace requires an explicit pricing model (price per unit + unit description). If you plan on multiple SKUs (e.g., standard/enterprise) flag that now.
- Co-sell: To enable co-sell, well need a Partner Contact (POC), an AWS-ready technical contact, and a one-page solution brief. Also complete the co-sell intake form Ill send after we get the listing ID.
- Security/compliance: upload SOC 2 summary and any regional data handling notes. If the product is region-restricted, call that out.
- Assets: Tile image (1280x640), logo (PNG, 600x150), short screenshot set (3 images), and an optional 30s demo video (mp4, <50MB).

Ive ccd Marketplace partner onboarding in case they have follow-ups. I can take the Tuesday slot at 10:00 PT. Send a calendar invite and the latest copy before then.

Regards,
Suresh Patel
AWS Marketplace Partner Lead
Suresh.patel@amazon.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 08:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace listing: product page text + asset onboarding

Thanks Vanessa — I made a pass on the draft and pulled out quick copy edits and a sharper headline. See notes below and attached copy v2.

Headline suggestion (short): "Redwood Inference: High-performance LLM inference, rentable by token or hour"
Short description (30 words): "Low-latency, cost-efficient LLM inference runtime. Supports hosted, dedicated, and private deployments with automated batching, KV caching, and enterprise security controls."
Bullets (benefits):
- Predictable throughput and cost controls for production workloads
- Turnkey deployment options: hosted API, dedicated GPU pools, private VPC
- Observability & cost breakdowns at token-level for optimization

Call to action: "Request a demo or deploy a free trial via AWS Marketplace."

Other items:
- We should include a line about supported frameworks (PyTorch, ONNX) and quantization options.
- Add one example customer use case (e.g., conversational agent for support) to illustrate value.

Attached: aws_listing_copy_v2.docx (v2 with edits + alt tile options)

Ill draft the 1-pager for co-sell and can take the meeting Tue 10:00 PT as well. Jonas, can you confirm the SOC2 stub and the legal contact for the MSA upload?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
